questions.q: Which library is the first choice for fast classical models on a million series?
why: Too slow and not always accurate.

questions.q: Forecasts for stores must add up to the national forecast. Which tool?
Put the work in a sensible order: first step.
Which statements are good practice? (pick all)
options: Compare libraries on the same rolling backtest
Use deep learning first on small data
Choose tools the team can maintain
why: Small data does not support deep models well.

questions.q: Scenario: 30 monthly series, no covariates. What is a reasonable approach?
options: Seasonal naive, ETS, ARIMA/Theta, and their combination, compared on a rolling backtest
why: Too many features for so little data.

questions.q: Scenario: you must classify 50 000 vibration recordings as faulty or normal. Which family?
options: aeon, sktime or tsfresh with a classifier
